description: This is a test class for the TimedNoticeHelper, containing multiple unit tests that verify its behavior in different scenarios, including timing and provider-based configurations.

classes.name: TimedNoticeHelperTest
classes.description: A test suite for the TimedNoticeHelper class, verifying its timing logic and provider-based behavior.

methods.name: testHappyPath
methods.description: Verifies the basic timing behavior of TimedNoticeHelper with fixed delay.

methods.name: testHappyPathWithProvider
methods.description: Tests the helper with a provider that increments the delay, verifying timing adjustments.

methods.name: testHappyPathWithProviderWithInputTimesShown
methods.description: Tests the helper with a provider that adds to the delay, checking timing after multiple increments.

methods.name: testInitialData
methods.description: Checks the helper's behavior when initial data is set in shared preferences, ensuring timing logic respects stored timestamps.

methods.name: testPushesShowTimeLaterIfShownAgain
methods.description: Verifies that the helper delays subsequent shows after being marked as shown.
